title: MemSim: A Bayesian Simulator for Evaluating Memory of LLM-based Personal Assistants
one_line: Bayesian simulator for LLM assistant memory with causal QA generation
innovations: Bayesian Relation Network for diverse user profiles
Causal generation mechanism to mitigate LLM hallucinations
MemDaily benchmark for comprehensive memory evaluation
method_framework: MemSim uses Bayesian Relation Network to model user entities and attributes, then employs causal generation to create reliable QAs from shared hints, ensuring factual consistency while maintaining diversity.
experiment_framework: Evaluated on MemDaily dataset with 2,954 trajectories across 6 QA types, using human evaluators and GPT-4o for profile and message quality assessment.
takeaways: Causal generation from shared hints ensures QA reliability
Hierarchical user profiles enhance diversity and scalability
weaknesses: Potential inconsistency between human and LLM evaluators
